name: 2017 bubble peak
description: The CoinDesk Bitcoin Price Index hit its all-time high of $19,783.21 on 17 Dec 2017, the top of the 2017 bubble

name: 2018 crash capitulation
description: Bitcoin fell about 65% between 6 Jan and 6 Feb 2018; 5 Feb is the largest daily-close drop of that sell-off in our data (BTC -16%)

name: COVID Black Thursday
description: COVID-19 market crash: bitcoin fell about 30% from 8 to 12 Mar 2020; 12 Mar is BTC's largest daily-close drop in our data

name: China bans financial institutions from crypto services
description: China's banking, internet-finance and payment associations barred financial and payment institutions from crypto-related services (registration, trading, clearing, settlement); bitcoin fell 7.3% to $40,139 in Asian trading

name: Terra UST depeg / LUNA collapse
description: UST redemptions ramped up on 9 May 2022; LUNA fell 48% that day and LUNA supply hyperinflated about 80x from 10 to 12 May. The original chain was later renamed Terra Classic and its token LUNA Classic (LUNC)

name: Celsius withdrawal freeze / Three Arrows
description: Celsius paused all withdrawals, swaps and transfers on 13 Jun 2022 citing extreme market conditions; on-chain analysis shows Three Arrows Capital began unwinding its stETH positions on 13-14 Jun

name: FTX collapse
description: After Binance said it would sell its FTT holdings, FTT lost about 80% of its value on 8 Nov 2022; FTX halted crypto withdrawals and filed for bankruptcy on 11 Nov

name: SVB failure / USDC depeg
description: Regulators seized Silicon Valley Bank on 10 Mar 2023; Circle held $3.3 billion (about 8%) of USDC cash reserves there and USDC traded below its $1 peg on 10-11 Mar until the 12 Mar deposit guarantee

name: US spot BTC ETF approval
description: The SEC approved the listing and trading of spot bitcoin exchange-traded product shares on 10 Jan 2024

name: Yen carry-trade unwind
description: After the Bank of Japan's 31 Jul rate rise and a weak US jobs report on 2 Aug, leveraged yen carry trades unwound; the Nikkei 225 and Topix fell more than 12% on 5 Aug 2024, the steepest one-day drop since 1987

name: Oct-10 liquidation cascade
description: A 100% China-tariff headline triggered about $19 billion of crypto leverage liquidated in roughly a day on 10 Oct 2025
